$comment: Each entry is one behaviour of the chat pipeline, stated as the mutation that removes it from the current tree, the scenario that exercises it, and the oracle (apps/api/src/tests/helpers/chat-oracles.ts) that must fail when it is gone. Run: bun apps/api/scripts/chat-mutation-matrix.ts. An entry whose mutation no longer applies fails until it is replaced or retired with a reason.

entries.behaviour: The interrupt snapshot carries one assistant message per id, merging the copies the engine splits at each tool result.
entries.reason: The behaviour is not on the tree yet; the scenario tests stay marked failing until it is.

scenario.test: keeps every card after an approval on a message that already holds a tool result

entries.reason: The web client echoes the adapter's normalized input (TOOL_CALL_END.input), so no request the page builds carries strict-mode nulls and the mutation cannot fail there; chat-schema.continuation.property.test.ts covers the comparison with generated echoes, and the scenario stays as the end-to-end strict-null check.
